known_issues: After Version 18 deployment, app can get stuck in loading/skeleton state on mobile and not render the monthly totals.

existing_features.title: Prevent the app from staying indefinitely in the loading/skeleton UI on mobile by ensuring actor initialization failures and long-running actor initialization are surfaced to the UI as an error state (instead of keeping `isFetching/isLoading` true forever).

Add a user-visible recovery path when loading fails: provide a clear error UI (English text) with a primary action to retry loading (refetch/recreate actor + refetch habits) without requiring the user to close the tab.

Adjust the loading-state logic in the main view so that it does not rely on a condition that can remain true indefinitely (e.g., `isInitializing`/actor fetching) and so that error states take precedence over skeleton rendering for authenticated users.

new_feature_requests.summary: Harden actor initialization so it cannot hang indefinitely: wrap actor creation and `_initializeAccessControlWithSecret(...)` in a timeout and propagate timeout/initialization errors through `useActor()` so `useHabits()`/`BecomingView` can render an error instead of remaining stuck in a loading state.

projectName: Fix mobile app stuck on loading/skeleton after Version 18
